verdict.rationale: Ollama documents running its own Ollama Cloud models alongside local models through the same tooling: `ollama launch` works with local or cloud models, and the API has local and cloud base URLs. The evidence covers only Ollama's first-party cloud, not connecting to third-party providers; its OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility lets those clients call Ollama, the opposite direction. Missing for 10: connection to third-party cloud AI providers (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic) from within Ollama, documented unified switching between local and cloud models in one interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect to cloud AI providers alongside local models within the same interface
